title: Super day!
text:
This was a fantastic tour!  Pablo was our guide and he was awesome!  Super fun, on time, helpful, and best of all he showed us everything we asked for in a limited timeframe we gave him because we had tickets to a show Earle e in g so he had to adjust our tour to fit it in.  Took us to a great kettle restaurant and we even got to see a parade that was passing g.  He was happy to take pictures for us and he was friendly and not flustered when we veered off the beaten path!  
Super day!!
author: DianeLove12

title: Excellent Tou
text: Excellent tour.  Our guide, Marta, was excellent.  Very knowledgeable about the area and delightful to tour with our family.
author: Bruce_C

title: Julia’s tours with Paula
text: Paula was our tour guide. She was amazing. Our first tour of the park was in Spanish and English. She was enthusiastic about leading our group. She was full of information about Sagrada. We continued to the Sagrada Familia. This tour was in English. I learned so much about Gaudi from Paula. She was full of details about Gaudi’s work
author: Jackifb

title: Nice young guide with contemporary explanation
text: Our guide was very nice and knowledgable. We had a good time chatting about the park and basculica, as well as current life in Spain.
author: Yufang_S

title: Great Experience
text: Raoul was great and very patient with our family with kids. We were able to see everything without rushing.
author: Erin_M

title: Gaudi, Gaudi, and some more Gaudi!
text:
Our guide, Ramon, was a delight from start to finish.  His manner was friendly and engaging, his English very good, and he was full of information about the homes on the tour as well as broad background for the history of Barcelona's Modernist era.  Casa Batllo was fantastic, even though parts of the house were under restoration and the crowds were large. 

Ramon navigated our way to Sagrada Familia with an eye on our not missing our ticketed entrance time.  He gave us a lot of background on the development of the church, before and after Gaudi's death.  Before leaving us to go into the cathed
author: RACHEL_J

title: Jorje was an absolute delight!  He was...
text: Jorje was an absolute delight! He was punctual and very informative, giving us a wonderful overview of all things Gaudi. My daughter and I thoroughly enjoyed out morning walking tour with Jorje - couldn't have asked for a better or nicer guide!
author: MARIA M

title: Amazing
text: A fabulous tour! Jorje was terrific; timely, charming, informative, and very willing to tailor things to our personal needs. At the end we felt we had done exactly what we asked for.
author: Jeri_H
